positions.title: Vault | Personal finance visualization tool
positions.description:
- Integrated React hooks and Context API to form a centralized state tree, allowing consistent data flow and avoiding complicated prop drilling across nested components and unnecessary re-rendering 

- Implemented Node/Express server to handle multiple HTTP requests, utilizing RESTful endpoints to connect client and server, and middleware controllers for a highly readable file-system and scalable backend development
